title_zh: 调整合唱话筒间距后重试长音

scenario.label_zh: 调整合唱话筒间距后重试长音
scenario.goal_zh: 明确要检查的是长音时的声部平衡并约定拉开话筒间距后重唱检查

context_zh: 合唱排练中，声乐成员和负责录音的同伴检查两个话筒收音的平衡。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: My vocal line disappears under Jo's on the recording.

sentences.speaker: Erin
sentences.text: Can you both sustain the final note while I check the balance?

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: Yes. Holding it isn't the problem; we can sing it together without stopping.

sentences.speaker: Erin
sentences.text: Then let's widen the gap between the microphone stands before you try it again.

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: All right. I'll wait until you've moved them, then ask Jo to join me.

sentences.speaker: Erin
sentences.text: Thanks. We'll listen to the new recording before deciding whether that helped.
